newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Jan 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Jan 26.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Arab Bank and other banks set up an investment company with a capital of $60 million for investment in Egypt.
- The United States exported food to Gulf Arab states worth $785 million in nine months.
- Yemen's Central Bank issued treasury bills worth 11 billion rials.
- Nimir Petroleum Co of Saudi Arabia wins Oman exploration deal and negotiates with two countries to win new contracts.
